name: Tesla polyphase alternating-current motor
description: A polyphase alternating-current motor used a rotating magnetic field for mechanical rotation.

places.note: Modern country or region reference, not a claim about historical boundaries.

events.statement: Nikola Tesla presented an alternating-current motor and power-distribution system to the American Institute of Electrical Engineers in New York.
events.caveats: Presentation is not the invention or first-sale date; Tesla acknowledged earlier AC motors.
